feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. Evidence: iteration 7 (mass 0.6 kg, body_length 0.12 m, wheel_track 0.10 m) scored 707.2, the best so far. Its oval was 20/20 at 1.79 s and its s-bend 20/20 with steering_oscillation 0.311. Its slalom was 0/20, with progress up from 0.30 to 0.53 and line_loss_events 1.3. Iteration 8 (wheel_track 0.09 m) showed that more turn authority cost s-bend finishes (19/20) and raised jitter to 0.342, while slalom progress fell to 0.42, so the track should stay at 0.10 m. Lowering yaw inertia (mass 0.5 kg) is the lever still moving the slalom. Next-race rules: if slalom progress rises above 0.53 and line_loss_events fall toward 1.0 while the s-bend stays at 19/20 or better with steering_oscillation under 0.35, keep mass 0.5 kg and consider it the new best geometry. If slalom progress rises but line_loss_events stay at about 1.3 or more, do not reduce mass or track further; report the heading at first line loss so the next step can change controller entry speed instead of geometry. If the s-bend steering_oscillation exceeds 0.35 or the score falls below 707, return to mass 0.6 kg with wheel_track 0.10 m.
